messages:
Iris: Flagging a handful of UX nits from the latest prototype test. The compare table on 1366px width lost the primary metric column when filters were open. Users kept horizontal-scrolling and missed latency values.
Ben: Saw the same. Two viable approaches: sticky primary metric column OR auto-collapse the filter rail when entering compare mode. Sticky seems less surprising.
Kaya: If we sticky, header height needs to shrink ~8px to avoid overlapping the compare controls. Also add a subtle divider shadow so people know it's pinned.
Omar: Performance badges are visually loud. Suggest a fade-back style: small status dot + abbreviated label (e.g., "L:120ms") and hover expands full metric. Keeps scan weight on numbers.
Zoe: Accessibility: dot + color isn't enough. Each status needs an accessible label like aria-label="Latency p95: 120ms (good)" and a text fallback in the popover.
Iris: Pinning mental model problem: participants assumed pin respects filters. In reality it persists. We need to make scope explicit at the moment of pinning.
Ben: Lightweight pattern: when a user clicks pin show a tiny inline choice: [Pin globally] [Pin to this search]. Default to "Pin to this search" if that matches current user flows.
Kaya: Also show a persistent header pill when anything is pinned: "Pinned: v3.0.1 ". Clicking the pill opens pin settings. This prevents the "where did my pin go" problem after filter changes.
Omar: Microcopy: change button text from "Pin" to "Pin model version" and menu option "Pin scope: global / current search". Longer but clearer.
Zoe: Keyboard focus order is odd: tab lands in the badge popover close before metrics. Fix to move focus to first metric item on open. Add role="dialog" and focus trap for expanded inline lists.
Iris: Mobile: collapse secondary badges into a single "+n metrics" chip that expands inline below the row. Avoid horizontal scrolling on phones.
Ben: For desktop overflow show first two badges + "+n". On click expand inline and set focus to the first expanded metric (keyboard users).
Kaya: CSS suggestion for compact badges: keep visual 20x20 but ensure .hit-area >=32px via padding; use outline on focus for keyboard users.
Omar: Motion: small scale + fade when pinning makes the action feel confirmed. Keep duration <=160ms and avoid layout paints (use transform + opacity).
Zoe: A11y checklist to add to PR: contrast >=4.5:1 for small badge text, aria-labels for badges, aria-live for pin/unpin confirmations, keyboard order for expand/collapse.
DesignBot: Reminder: update the i18n key list for new copy ("Pin model version", "Pin scope: global", "Pin scope: current search").
Iris: QA note: file a test for "pinned highlight persists across filter group changes". I reproduced it disappearing in staging twice.
Ben: Also add E2E for hit-target sizes on touch devices and keyboard navigation of the overflow.
Kaya: I'll mock the compact-badge + sticky-column variant in FigJam, Omar will prototype pin scope inline choice, Zoe will draft the a11y acceptance.
Omar: I'll add a small animation spec and CSS hint for the transform-only approach.
Zoe: I'll write the ARIA patterns and example screen reader strings, and test in VoiceOver and NVDA once mocks are up.
Iris: Thanks all. Let's review Figma Wed 10:30am — please upload short GIFs of overflow expand and pin animation.
